inputs.description: Backup ZIP to push into the phone emulator's Downloads (e.g. takeout/parsed/hecate-takeout-20260912-1539.zip)
Which synthetic exercise Health Services should emit
Filename prefix for the two screenshots
adb serial of the phone (see: adb devices -l)
adb serial of the watch (see: adb devices -l)

tasks.label: core: test
tasks.detail: The algorithms — matcher, clustering, profile maths, CPU budget. No SDK needed. Run this constantly.

tasks.label: core: test (rerun, no cache)
tasks.detail: Force a full re-run when you suspect a stale cache is hiding a failure.

tasks.label: phone: unit test
tasks.detail: The backup archive's ZIP/JSON layer. Plain JVM, no Robolectric.

tasks.label: build: core + phone + wear (debug)
tasks.detail: The full first-run / sanity build from the README.

tasks.label: phone: install release
tasks.detail: Requires keystore.properties. Targets only phoneSerial — both apps share the applicationId de.hecate, so an untargeted install lands on every connected device, phone and watch alike.

tasks.label: wear: install release
tasks.detail: Requires keystore.properties. Targets only wearSerial — both apps share the applicationId de.hecate, so an untargeted install lands on every connected device, phone and watch alike.

tasks.label: emu: up
tasks.detail: Boots both AVDs — hecate_watch4 on emulator-5554, hecate_pixel8 on emulator-5556. Ports are pinned, so the serials are stable. Already-running emulators are left alone.

tasks.label: emu: install (debug, both)
tasks.detail: Assembles and installs both debug APKs on the emulators only, then grants the runtime permissions. Never touches a real device: it passes -s explicitly, and a debug APK over the release install would cost an uninstall and any session not yet uploaded (§6.3).

tasks.label: emu: push backup archive
tasks.detail: Pushes a backup ZIP into the phone emulator's Downloads. Read it back in the app under Einstellungen → Sicherung einlesen → ☰ → Downloads.

tasks.label: emu: start synthetic exercise
tasks.detail: Switches Health Services to its synthetic providers and starts an exercise, so the watch's Live page has metrics to render. §6.5: one default route with identical values every run — plumbing and layout only, never the matcher.

tasks.label: emu: auto-pause broadcast
tasks.detail: Fires whs.AUTO_PAUSE_DETECTED, the event injection §6.5 names for exercising auto-pause handling.

tasks.label: emu: screenshot both
tasks.detail: Writes <prefix>-watch.png and <prefix>-phone.png in the workspace root.

tasks.label: emu: logcat (watch)
tasks.detail: Tails the watch emulator for the app's own tag and uncaught exceptions.

tasks.label: adb: forward jdwp (phone)
tasks.detail: Forwards the phone app's JDWP port to localhost:5005 for the attach debug config.
tasks.command: adb -s ${input:phoneSerial} forward tcp:5005 jdwp:$(adb -s ${input:phoneSerial} shell pidof de.hecate)

tasks.label: adb: forward jdwp (wear)
tasks.detail: Forwards the watch app's JDWP port to localhost:5006 for the attach debug config.
tasks.command: adb -s ${input:wearSerial} forward tcp:5006 jdwp:$(adb -s ${input:wearSerial} shell pidof de.hecate)
